traditional_use: Used as a wall, doorway or decorative covering in the traditional Somali aqal dwelling.
story_so: Kabad waa shayga saddexaad ee ku qoran diiwaanka madxafka. Diiwaanku wuxuu ku tilmaamayaa gogol afar-gees ah oo gacanta lagu tolay, lehna midabbo kala duwan iyo naqshado joomatari ah oo xariijimo leh. Waxaa laga sameeyey fiilooyin dhir iyo kuwo dhar ah. Waxaa loo isticmaali jiray in lagu daboolo derbiga ama albaabka, ama lagu qurxiyo aqal-dhaqameedka Soomaaliyeed.
story_en: Kebed/Kabad is identified as artifact 3 in the supplied inventory. It is described as a colorful rectangular handwoven mat featuring striped geometric patterns. Made from plant and textile fibers, it was traditionally used as a wall, doorway or decorative covering in the Somali aqal dwelling.
